skills.name: Basic
skills.desc: Deals a 3-hit combo to a single target for 35% ATK (+3) damage.

skills.name: Ultimate
skills.desc: Deals a 5-hit combo to all enemies for 17% ATK (+2) damage. If self is in the [Berserk] state, restore HP.

skills.name: Ultra-Ultimate
skills.desc: Deals a 5-hit combo to all enemies for 17% ATK (+2) damage, and directly restores own HP. At the same time, attacks from surrounding allies ignore 20% DEF for a duration.

skills.name: Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases own HP by (+20). When battle begins, grants herself 30% [Non-Crit DMG Free] (effective for all DMG types, cannot co-exist with [Agility]). Removes [Fear] from allies after they act.

skills.name: Extreme Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases own HP by (+20). When battle begins, grants herself 30% [Non-Crit DMG Free] and an ally in the same column 10% [Non-Crit DMG Free] (all DMG types, cannot co-exist with [Agility]). Removes [Fear] from allies after they act.

skills.name: 5★ Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases own HP by (+20). When battle begins, grants herself 35% [Non-Crit DMG Free] and an ally in the same column 15% [Non-Crit DMG Free] (all DMG types, cannot co-exist with [Agility]). Removes [Fear] from allies after they act.

effects.desc: The shield absorbs damage over time and damage types (Damage, Internal Damage, Charge).
